title: The Steamer Chicora, 1895: the Warning That Came Too Late

sources.what: left Milwaukee for St. Joseph about 5 a.m. Jan. 21; owner wired the captain, but she had sailed; spars and wreckage ashore between South Haven and Saugatuck; crew of 23 and one passenger
sources.who: J.B. Mansfield, History of the Great Lakes (1899)

sources.what: cargo of flour; left ten minutes ahead of a messenger with the owner's warning; no bodies recovered; never found; masts bought by Douglas
'left Milwaukee yesterday morning'; 'Twenty-six lives have been lost'
left Milwaukee early Monday, Jan. 21; 22 aboard; wreck never found
45 mph gale that afternoon and a blizzard; a dog appeared at a door south of Benton Harbor
'a snuff colored Skye terrier ... covered with ice' found near Benton Harbor

beats.text: The warning came too late. The ship had already sailed.
beats.label: LAKE MICHIGAN, 1895
beats.credit: Michigan Shipwreck Research Association · AI-generated picture

beats.text: On January 21, 1895, the steamer Chicora left Milwaukee before dawn, bound for her home port, Saint Joseph, Michigan.
beats.label: JANUARY 21, 1895

beats.text: Her owner sent a warning not to sail. She was already gone.
beats.label: THE WARNING
beats.credit: Michigan Shipwreck Research Association · AI-generated picture

beats.text: That day, a gale and a blizzard tore across the lake.
beats.label: THE STORM
beats.credit: Wisconsin Marine Historical Society · AI-generated picture

beats.text: The Chicora never made port. Everyone aboard, about two dozen people, was lost.
beats.label: ALL LOST
beats.credit: Michigan Shipwreck Research Association · AI-generated picture

beats.text: Wreckage washed up between South Haven and Saugatuck. Near Saint Joseph, a little terrier known to have been aboard came ashore, alive.
beats.label: THE WRECKAGE
beats.credit: Mansfield (1899); Buffalo Enquirer (1895); Wisconsin Marine Historical Society

beats.text: The Chicora has never been found.
beats.label: NEVER FOUND
beats.credit: Michigan Shipwreck Research Association · AI-generated picture

factcheck.result: the dog came ashore near St. Joseph, not with the wreckage; 'ALL HANDS' became 'ALL LOST'; lightning and the small boat removed; all supported
